questions.text:
The simplified architecture of a web application consists of three main components.

(a)   Name these three components of the web application architecture as discussed
      in Chapter 1 of the textbook. (3 marks)
(b)   Briefly explain the purpose of these three components. (3 marks)
(c)   What is the role of PHP in the architecture? (2 marks)
(d)   Name an available technology for each of the component of the web application
      architecture. Indicate which technology corresponds to which component in the
      architecture. (3 marks)
(e)   Your assignment 4 was presented as a web application. List and explain four
      tools/applications you have used to present your assignment 4 as a web
      application. (4 marks)
questions.correctAnswer:
(a) Web browser/client, web server, database server.
(b) Browser sends requests and displays pages; web server receives/processes HTTP requests; database server stores and returns records.
(c) PHP runs on the server to process request inputs, handle application logic, query databases and generate HTML.
(d) Chrome (browser), Apache (web server), MySQL (database).
(e) Example tools: VS Code for editing PHP, XAMPP (Apache/PHP) for local testing, MySQL/phpMyAdmin for managing stored data, and a hosting/FTP tool for publishing the application. Other equivalent justified tools are acceptable.

Study the code below to answer the questions that follow:

```html
<form action="processcode.php" method="get">
<label> Module code: </label>
<input type="text" name="code">
<input type="submit" value="Submit">
</form>
```

(a) What is rendered by the code above? (2 marks)
(b) Write PHP code for processcode.php to process the form. The PHP code must
    first check if the form is completed fully by the user. If the form is incomplete,
    display a message to inform the user that the form is incomplete. If the form is
    filled in completely, then extract the first three characters from the input string. If
    the first three characters of the input string are ICT, then it is a Diploma module.
    A module is in Computer Science or Information Systems, if the first three
    characters of the input string are COS or INF respectively. For example, consider
    the module code ICT2613, it is a Diploma module because the module code starts
    with the string ICT. Use an associative array to generate and display the stream
    represented by the input string. (9 marks)
    PHP notes: The PHP function substr($input,                          $startingPos,
    $characterCount)can extract and return a number of characters (represented
    by $characterCount) from $input starting at the position $startingPos.

(c) What is the limitation of using an associative array for the purpose described in
    (b)? Give a solution to the limitation. (4 marks)
aiRubric: b) 9: GET field checking, substr, associative mapping

questions.text:
In Assignment 4, students were expected to design and implement a web-based
database application using MVC principle to manage learners and tours, and register
learners for the tours organised by the school.
The expected functionalities of the application were:

• One should be able to enter, modify, delete, store and view information about
  learners in the school.
• One should be able to enter, modify, store and view information about the tours
  held by the school.
• One should be able to register a learner for an upcoming tour. A learner must be
  only registered for the relevant grade-specific tour. It should be possible to delete
  the registration for an upcoming tour.
• One should be able to view a summary of the number of learners registered for the
  tours. Allow the user to view a summary of the tour, total number of learners
  registered for the tour and details of the registered learners.

(a) What are the database tables required for this application? Explain your answer.
    (4 marks)
(b) For each of the database tables listed in (a), what are the minimum columns
    required in each of them? Explain your design. (8 marks)
(c) What should happen when the user request to delete a learner in the relevant
    form? Explain the implications of this request for the database tables (as answered
    in (a)) and view of the entire application. (3 marks)
questions.correctAnswer:
(a) Learners, Tours and Registrations. Registrations connects learners to tours (many-to-many).
(b) Learners: learner_id primary key, name, grade. Tours: tour_id primary key, tour_name, start_date, end_date, eligible_grade. Registrations: registration_id primary key, learner_id foreign key, tour_id foreign key (or a composite key).
(c) On learner deletion, remove the learner and their registration rows safely (foreign keys/cascade or transaction), but retain the tours. Update learners, registration summaries and tour counts on the views.
aiRubric: c) 3: cascading registration deletion and view updates
questions.explanation:
Suggested study answer (not supplied as an official memo):

(a) Learners, Tours and Registrations. Registrations connects learners to tours (many-to-many).
(b) Learners: learner_id primary key, name, grade. Tours: tour_id primary key, tour_name, start_date, end_date, eligible_grade. Registrations: registration_id primary key, learner_id foreign key, tour_id foreign key (or a composite key).
(c) On learner deletion, remove the learner and their registration rows safely (foreign keys/cascade or transaction), but retain the tours. Update learners, registration summaries and tour counts on the views.

Student note: Many-to-many relationships should use a junction/registration table with foreign keys.

In Assignment 4, students were expected to design and implement a web-based
database application using MVC principle to manage learners and tours, and register
learners for the tours organised by the school.
The expected functionalities of the application were:

• One should be able to enter, modify, delete, store and view information about
  learners in the school.
• One should be able to enter, modify, store and view information about the tours
  held by the school.
• One should be able to register a learner for an upcoming tour. A learner must be

  the registration for an upcoming tour.
• One should be able to view a summary of the number of learners registered for the
  tours. Allow the user to view a summary of the tour, total number of learners
  registered for the tour and details of the registered learners.

(a) Explain what MVC principle entails. (3 marks)
(b) Give and explain an example of a file each for the different elements of MVC that
     is applicable in this application. (6 marks)
(c) Explain how you implement the requirement A learner must be only registered for
   the relevant grade-specific tour in the application. Your explanation should refer to
   the relevant models and views. (3 marks)
(d) Assume that the starting and ending dates of tours are stored in DateTime objects.
     Write PHP code to check if a learner can be registered for a tour by comparing the
     current date to the start date of the tour. Store the outcome/result as a Boolean
     value. (3 marks)
questions.explanation:
Suggested study answer (not supplied as an official memo):

(a) MVC means Model (data/rules), View (presentation) and Controller (handles requests and coordinates model/view).
(b) Model: Learner.php or Tour.php for data and eligibility. View: tour_form.php for the HTML list/form. Controller: TourController.php for request validation and navigation.
(c) Compare the learner's grade and tour's eligible grade using the models; list allowed tours in the view and reject mismatched submissions on the server.
(d) Example:
$today=new DateTime('today');
$mayRegister=($today < $tourStartDate);

Student note: Validate grade-specific tour eligibility on the server, not only in the user interface.

   solution. You need not rewrite the entire code but only indicate necessary
